pages.text: It was a summer night. Mom hung a lamp by the door, glowing yellow. Across the stream, fireflies sparkled above the grass.
"I want to see fireflies up close." Mumu stood on tiptoe.
Dodo pointed at the doorway. "Fireflies like bright things. Under the lamp is the prime spot! That means the very best place. I know!"
They sat side by side beneath the lamp. A bright circle of light shone around them.
They waited, but only moths fluttered there. Not a single firefly came.
"They'll be here soon. Fireflies are sleepyheads," Dodo said, pretending to know.
Mumu looked at the dark grass by the stream. Tiny lights danced and sparkled there.
Mumu walked softly over and sat in the dark grass. Only insects chirped.
Blink, blink. Fireflies gathered around Mumu.
Dodo came softly and sat beside him. One firefly settled on her ribbon, another on his neck scarf. Holding their breath, they looked at each other and grinned.
